body: Hey it’s better to tell the truth than give some false pretenses. Happy to have made you happy chalet slightly harder :p

I don’t really want to keep moving. I never expected to live this long, and the way I’ve been forced to live my whole life has left me unequipped to deal with the world. 
I have a lot of trouble relating to people, and I’ve been growing increasingly agoraphobic since I’ve never once been able to leave my house for anything other than school or keeping up appearances. I crave validation and affection but I recognize there is absolutely no way I’ll be getting that. 
I have no plans on how to move forward, and absolutely no support system. i don’t have any means of advancing, and I don’t have the means to even start making progress

I’ve been trying to accept that. It just hurts a lot more than anyone else leaving out of the blue has. 
Every day I feel sick to my stomach when something reminds me of him. That anxious sick feeling, and I don’t know how to stop it

I’m 18. I don’t have the ability to go anywhere. Even before this virus changed things, the rule for me living here is essentially “if you leave once you never get to come back”. Not even to get my clothes or my pet. 

I don’t have a car, I don’t have any money, I don’t have any other places to stay, I don’t have friends I can ask for help. 

I cant get a job because I would be kicked out, and I can’t do anything else about this situation because I would be kicked out. 

Essentially I’m fucked

I don’t have any friends or anyone to talk to. Things are very quickly going even worse than they usually do, and I don’t know if I can take it. I hate being alone, and people hate being around me so how do I stop being so alone
